```yaml
name: Careful Rebase Workflow

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up JDK 11
      uses: actions/setup-java@v2
      with:
        java-version: '11'
        distribution: 'adopt'

    - name: Install Maven
      run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y maven

    - name: Run pre-rebase base-only improvement detection
      run: |
        git diff --name-only $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD | grep -E '\.(sh|yml)$' > base_only_files.txt
        if [ -s base_only_files.txt ]; then
          echo "::warning::Base-only files detected:"
          cat base_only_files.txt
          read -p "Do you want to proceed with the rebase? (yes/no)" response
          if [[ $response != "yes" ]]; then
            exit 1
          fi
        fi

    - name: Run mandatory answer-session policy
      run: |
        echo "default_policy=NEVER" > .answer_session_policy

    - name: Run post-rebase regression scan
      run: |
        git diff --name-only $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD | grep -E '\.(sh|yml)$' > base_only_files.txt
        if [ -s base_only_files.txt ]; then
          echo "::error::Regressions detected in base-only files:"
          cat base_only_files.txt
          exit 1
        fi
        git diff --numstat | awk '{add+=$1; subs+=$2} END {printf "Total changes: %d\n", add-subs}'
        if [ $(git diff --numstat | awk '{add+=$1; subs+=$2} END {print add-subs}') -lt 0 ]; then
          echo "::error::Intentional net deletions detected."
          exit 1
        fi
```
